nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Master Django settings shared across all environments for the LabConnect platform, configuring installed apps, middleware, PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, DRF with JWT (RS256), Celery task routing, Django Channels (Redis), MinIO object storage, OTP, Firebase, CORS, i18n (French/Arabic), brute-force protection via django-axes, and structured logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses django-environ for 12-factor environment variable loading. Defines a private helper _b64_decode to decode base64-encoded RSA keys from env vars for RS256 JWT signing. Bilingual (French/Arabic) with Africa/Nouakchott timezone.

nodes.name: dev.py
nodes.summary: Development environment Django settings that override base.py, enabling DEBUG, relaxing CORS to allow all local network and LAN IP ranges for Expo Go mobile development, switching JWT from RS256 to HS256 with SECRET_KEY, and using the console email backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN_REGEXES with private LAN IP patterns to support Expo Go's web preview and native fetch without opening CORS to all origins.

nodes.name: prod.py
nodes.summary: Production Django settings targeting Render.com free tier with Supabase Postgres, configuring DATABASE_URL-based connection with PostGIS and SSL, WhiteNoise static file serving, synchronous Celery (eager mode, no Redis), full HTTPS security headers (HSTS, SSL redirect, secure cookies), optional Sentry error tracking, and HS256 JWT fallback when RS256 keys are absent.
nodes.languageNotes: Designed for Render.com free tier: disables Django Channels (WebSocket) and real Celery workers since no Redis broker is available, using in-memory channel layer and CELERY_TASK_ALWAYS_EAGER for demo deployments.
